products.body_html:
Adds wireless connectivity to a subwoofer when paired with an existing SoundPath Tri-Band Wireless Audio Adapter transmitter. Up to 6 total receivers can be added to a single transmitter.

NOTE: This product does not include the transmitter. It is only for adding multiple wireless subwoofers to an existing SoundPath Tri-Band Wireless Adapter transmitter.

products.title: Aurelian Mira Accessory
products.body_html:
Transmits a pristine LFE or full-range stereo audio signal up to 130-feet at 16-bit/48KHz with ultra-low latency. Tri-Band technology auto-switches between three wireless bands for use in crowded wireless signal areas where single-band wireless transmitters are prone to interference. Wirelessly connects subwoofers, powered speakers, and more.

Setup of the SoundPath Tri-Band Wireless Audio Adapter takes minutes. Once installed, it auto-switches between the 2.4 GHz, 5.2 GHz, and 5.8 GHz wireless bands for uninterrupted audio signal transfer. Impervious to interference from Bluetooth, Wi-Fi routers, wireless security systems, cameras, and other wireless devices.
